title.value: Improving Reproducibility in Machine Learning Research
title.justification: The title is directly provided at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote:
Improving Reproducibility in Machine Learning Research
( A Report from the NeurIPS 2019 Reproducibility Program )

analysis.description: This paper discusses the NeurIPS 2019 Reproducibility Program, focusing on improving the standards for conducting, communicating, and evaluating machine learning research through code submission policies, a reproducibility challenge, and a reproducibility checklist.

type.justification: The paper describes the practical implementation and observations of the NeurIPS 2019 Reproducibility Program, including data from the program's execution and community feedback.
type.quote: In 2019, the Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) conference, the premier international conference for research in machine learning, introduced a reproducibility program, designed to improve the standards across the community for how we conduct, communicate, and evaluate machine learning research.

name.justification: The paper discusses reproducibility in the context of machine learning research, specifically focusing on the NeurIPS conference.
name.quote: In 2019, the Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) conference, the premier international conference for research in machine learning, introduced a reproducibility program...

name.justification: The paper specifically targets reproducibility issues within the machine learning field, detailing initiatives to improve it.
name.quote: Reproducibility, that is obtaining similar results as presented in a paper or talk, using the same code and data (when available), is a necessary step to verify the reliability of research findings.
